statement.p: Note that it is reasonable to think that g'(x) = cg(x), where c is a constant, because the two graphs look very similar - it's possible the only difference between them is a vertical scaling.
Note also that g(0)=2^0=1, and you estimated g'(0) in part c.
If it is true that g'(x) = cg(x), what is the value of c?
